entities.name: Aariz Maddox
entities.description: A combatant possessing Bestiakinesis and Hyperkinesis who adapts through animal transformation, beast communication, and enhanced sensory awareness.
entities.quote: Together, they make Aariz a hunter-survivor, not a brute.

entities.name: Nyxia
entities.description: A figure whose abilities ignore physical forms.

entities.name: Agnus
entities.description: An individual capable of suppressing movement using Qahr.
entities.quote: ❌ Agnus can suppress movement with Qahr

timeline_events.title: Revelation of the Beast Realm
timeline_events.description: The Beast Realm is revealed, unlocking Aariz's Mimic Form ability to copy mythical beasts he has fought.
timeline_events.quote: Unlocked when the Beast Realm is revealed (Season 2).
